items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated remote code execution flaw (CVSS 9.1) allowing customer account takeover and full server control. Sansec reported mass attacks and active exploitation starting October 22, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-153 (BlockStrap RCE)
items.summary: Addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, BlockStrap, CVSS 10.0) allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B and stored cross-site scripting.

items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview
items.summary: Described as the "worst bug to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years," leading to crypt key theft, admin API token minting, customer data export, and skimmer injection. Sansec observed active exploitation starting September 16, 2026.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-138 (Multiple Vulnerabilities)
items.summary: Addresses eight vulnerabilities, six exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler RCE)
items.summary: Resolves a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, StyleSmuggler, CVSS 10.0) that could lead to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. Adobe confirmed exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: Addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that could result in privilege escalation.
